title: Forklift Daily Pre-Use Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Powered industrial trucks: check before each shift
instructions: Inspect the truck before it is used each shift. Mark one box for every item: OK, Defect or N/A.
If any defect affects safe operation, do not use the truck. Tag it out of service, remove the key and report it to your supervisor.
Do not return the truck to service until the defect is repaired. Add any checks your manufacturer's operator manual requires.

sections.title: Visual checks: power off, key removed
items: No visible damage, loose or missing parts. No build-up of grease, dust or debris.
No hydraulic oil, engine oil, coolant, fuel or battery acid under the truck.
No cuts, gouges, chunks or embedded objects. Wheel nuts secure. Pneumatic tyres at correct pressure.
No cracks, bends or excessive heel wear. Both locking pins in place and engaged.
Chains lubricated, no kinked, stretched or broken links. Anchor pins secure. Mast rails undamaged.
Fitted, secure, not bent or cracked.
Fitted, secure, not bent or cracked.
No cracks, chafing, bulges or weeping fittings.
Present, legible and correct for any attachment fitted.
Seat secure. Belt latches and retracts, webbing not cut or frayed.
Engine oil, hydraulic oil, coolant and brake fluid within marks, where applicable.
Warning decals legible. Operator manual on the truck.
Mounted, charged and in date, where fitted.

sections.title: Operational checks: truck running, area clear
items: All read normal. No fault codes or warning lights left on.
Headlights, beacon and travel/reversing alarm work, where fitted.
Turns smoothly lock to lock. No binding or excessive play.
Pedal firm. Truck stops smoothly and in a straight line.
Holds the truck. Warning light or alarm works, where fitted.
Drive and hydraulics cut out when the operator leaves the seat, where fitted.
Smooth through full height. No jerking, drifting or chain slack.
Smooth forward and back. Holds position with the lever released.
Operate correctly and are secured to the carriage.
None while travelling or using the hydraulics.

sections.title: Power source: complete the item that applies, mark the others N/A
items: Charged. Cables and connector undamaged. Terminals clean. Vent caps fitted. Battery restraint secure.
Secured in its bracket with locating pin engaged. Relief valve at the top. Hose and fittings undamaged. No smell of gas.
Enough fuel for the shift. Filler cap secure. No leaks. Exhaust undamaged, no heavy smoke.

references: 29 CFR 1910.178(q)(7): trucks must be examined before being placed in service, at least daily, and after each shift where used round the clock. A truck showing any condition that affects its safety must not be placed in service.
Source: eCFR, Title 29, Part 1910, Subpart N. Checks are a general guide; follow the manufacturer's operator manual for your truck.
disclaimer: General guidance only, not legal advice. Check the current regulation and your employer's procedures.
